# Cleanup

Review the entire codebase — Bicep, app code, and configuration — and make it lean, modular, and cost-effective.

## Goals

- **Infrastructure**: Right-size every resource. Don't over-provision. Don't under-provision. Match SKUs and capacities to actual workload needs.
- **App code**: Clean, modular, efficient, and idiomatic. Follow language and framework best practices.
- **Dead code**: Delete anything unused — files, functions, dependencies, settings, comments.
- **Config**: Remove stale or unreferenced settings.

Keep everything minimal. If it isn't earning its place, it goes.
